review_method: Individually viewed all 19 original native-client PNGs; no generated or edited screenshots.
limits: Native advancement toasts overlap upper-right chrome in 15 and 16; objective/actions remain readable.
Screenshots do not by themselves demonstrate 30-minute human mission pacing or complete every objective.

captures.name: 01-campaign-war-map-default
captures.review: Six legible faction-colored region cards; root/frontier links and 20% unlocks are visible; no overlapping controls.

captures.name: 02-campaign-plan-default
captures.review: Neon Docks, Turf Liberation, difficulty 10/10 and 30-minute plan are visible, with a clear pre-pod review action.

captures.name: 03-callin-catalog-default
captures.review: Search, unlocked/cost indicators and 125-entry pagination are legible with clear navigation.

captures.name: 04-chromageddon-equipped-default
captures.review: CHROMAGEDDON uses player-facing copy; actual purchase balance 270, cost 240, mission limit and equipped slot 4 are visible.

captures.name: 05-armory-all-weapons-default
captures.review: Primary/secondary/armor tabs, current selection, search and 68-entry pagination are legible.

captures.name: 06-armor-heavy-minimum
captures.review: Minimum logical size shows heavy-kit selection and 17 armor/6 toughness/−10% movement tradeoff; footer labels intentionally clip with readable controls.

captures.name: 07-armory-weapon-search-minimum
captures.review: Minimum-size native search resolves the exact Breaker and displays [SET]; long input scrolls horizontally as expected.

captures.name: 08-campaign-war-map-minimum
captures.review: All six region cards and three 20% route connectors fit at 320×240 logical pixels; faction colors, lock icons and main controls remain legible.

captures.name: 09-campaign-plan-minimum
captures.review: Difficulty 10/10,30-minute budget, mission text and review action remain readable at minimum size; secondary guidance uses an intentional ellipsis.

captures.name: 10-loadout-review-minimum
captures.review: Minimum review shows primary Breaker, secondary Peacemaker, heavy armor and all four selected call-ins, with edit controls and the explicit launch confirmation visible.

captures.name: 10b-loadout-review-scroll-minimum
captures.review: Scrolled minimum review reveals the mission-loan and original inventory/XP/world restoration explanation; all edit and launch controls remain in place.

captures.name: 11-loadout-review-default
captures.review: Default review fits the complete chosen loadout and restoration explanation without scrolling; explicit Confirm loadout/Launch pod is visible.

captures.name: 12-live-pod
captures.review: Visible physical pod surrounds its seated rider, heavy armor and skates are visible, and the mission HUD correctly says DROPPING.

captures.name: 13-selected-native-gun-hud
captures.review: Native selected Breaker model and ammunition HUD are visible in first person during an active mission, surrounded by actual themed enemy actors.

captures.name: 14-chromageddon-paint-blast
captures.review: Real pink/cyan graffiti covers nearby ground while enemies display damage/death effects; contemporaneous HUD reads 5/40 paint progress. This frame alone does not claim mission completion.

captures.name: 15-field-progress-minimum
captures.review: Minimum field controls and 1/5 secured status are readable. A native Monster Hunter toast overlaps the upper-right header; objective text, call-in controls and return action remain visible.

captures.name: 16-ship-hardware-minimum
captures.review: All four module names/prices,330 requisitions, armory and Return to Minecraft controls are legible. The transient native advancement toast overlaps upper-right subtitle chrome.

captures.name: 17-walkable-ship-deck
captures.review: Actual ship geometry is visible: continuous metal deck, marked yellow path, central platform, windows and roof beams. This still frame is supported by the native movement assertion for walkability.

captures.name: 18-returned-home-map
captures.review: Actual reopened war map is visible after return, with 330 requisitions and Neon Docks threat 30; all six regions and the Board your ship action remain legible.
